code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and lymphopenia, with elevated monocyte and basophil percentages. There is metabolic acidosis (low pH, low-normal bicarbonate), mild hypoxemia, and elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, and INR, suggesting inflammation and possible coagulopathy. Glucose is slightly low. These findings may indicate an acute inflammatory or infectious process with possible risk for thrombotic complications. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
